title: latc_check: independent checks for finite-domain decision-table completion
description:
Reference implementation, tests, transcribed worked example and result files for the re-examination of LATC (Learning Assistant through Cardinality) in "Where Declared Domains Are Lost: LATC, DMN Analysers and Public DMN Models". It regenerates or scores every result of the paper: exact completion over declared domains, LATC's readings, DMN gap and overlap analysis, the analyser audit, the public DMN corpus survey and the Lean formalisation.

Code is released under the MIT licence; the transcribed tables and result files under CC BY 4.0 (see LICENSE and LICENSE-DATA).
